name: Prestige Southern Star
overview: A self-contained premium residential community of 2,130 high-rise homes spanning over 30+ acres in Akshayanagar, Bannerghatta Road. Prestige Southern Star offers One, Two, Three and Four-Bed apartments in a wide range of layouts, with a home-office option in select layouts, over 80% open space including a central park, three swimming pools and a large clubhouse.
highlights: Over 80% open space, including a central park and festive lounges
Three swimming pools and a large, well-equipped clubhouse
Active fitness district: basketball, mini football, volleyball courts and a mini cricket ground
Home-office option available in select layouts
4 km from Hulimavu Road Metro Station (Pink Line)
3 km from Singasandra Metro Station (Yellow Line)
Excellent connectivity via Bannerghatta Road and NICE Road
amenities: Large clubhouse with recreational, social & fitness facilities
